temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days during a busy, stressful week at the bank. When Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging, so her recent quietness and withdrawal are uncharacteristic and may mean something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated: Marilyn confirms she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues; her quietness is likely stress-related rather than a reaction to Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling with work and personal stress and may need support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and remain available if Marilyn wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responds curtly in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and hurt. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and hopes to clear misunderstandings, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed with work and personal issues and may appreciate support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Initially changed to confusion and hurt, with worry that Carolyn overstepped; then revised when Marilyn explains her curtness was due to a hard week and that she appreciates Carolyn's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's curtness was not a personal rejection; she is struggling and values Carolyn's supportive approach.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and hurt, then empathetic and somewhat reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear the misunderstanding, show support, and respect Marilyn's boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness. Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend get-together, and Marilyn says it sounds lovely and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes her supportive conversation with Marilyn went well and that their friendship may be developing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated: Marilyn accepts the social invitation and expresses interest in joining.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in deepening their friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the gathering and strengthen her bond with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this directly, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn accepted her social invitation and that their friendship is growing outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated to disappointment when Marilyn still seems professionally distant at work; then revised when Marilyn says the distance was unintentional and she is open to improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn may not have meant to create distance; their work dynamic can improve through direct conversation and clearer expectations.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address their work dynamic, clarify expectations and boundaries, and improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal. Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they had their talk, and is looking forward to working more closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and strengthened: Marilyn is enthusiastic about collaborating and values their improved understanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is stronger, and they can work closely together with mutual understanding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up on the new project proposal and further their collaborative partnership.
